option.name: SCRIPT_TEXT
option.value: if ! docker info > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Error: Docker is not running. Please start Docker/OrbStack and try again.'; exit 1; fi; if docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml ps postgres --format json 2>/dev/null | grep -q '\"State\":\"running\"'; then echo 'Database is already running.'; else docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres; fi
